properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs evidence_read, Grade, grade_of; reasoning.rs EvidenceItem; add_requirement / add_constraint fields). statement_kind `evidence` and `judgement`; source_reliability (A–F), information_credibility (1–6), reported_at, confidence (low/moderate/high) stored as indexed fields. Evidence reads cited_as_evidence when a pinned Artifact DOCUMENTS it, evidence_unverified otherwise; it holds as evidence, so what rests on it reads supported (an objection resting on it contests, never refutes). Since 2026-10-21 (phase 6 PR 5, dec:idea-what-rests-on-unsourced-evidence-reads-supported-or-conditional chose (b)): what rests on a report no pinned source documents reads CONDITIONAL on it until its source is documented — the capstone's A3 consistency check, resting on R4, went from supported to conditional. reasoning_report lists every piece of evidence and judgement with its grade; each claim carries its grade.
properties.name: A report is recorded as evidence with its source grade, cited as evidence through the source that documents it, and what rests on it reads supported, never proven
